namespace PhpCsFixer\Fixer\PhpTag;

use PhpCsFixer\AbstractFixer;
use PhpCsFixer\Fixer\WhitespacesAwareFixerInterface;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\CodeSample;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\FixerDefinition;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\FixerDefinitionInterface;
use PhpCsFixer\Preg;
use PhpCsFixer\Tokenizer\Token;
use PhpCsFixer\Tokenizer\Tokens;

/**
 * @author Ceeram <ceeram@cakephp.org>
 */
final class BlankLineAfterOpeningTagFixer extends AbstractFixer implements WhitespacesAwareFixerInterface
{
    private int $openingTagIndex = 0;

    private string $openingTagContent = '';

    private bool $openingTagHasLinebreak = false;

    private string $capturedLineEnding = "\n";

    private string $capturedFilePath = '';

    private bool $singleLineFile = false;

    private ?int $closingTagIndex = null;

    private bool $fileIsMonolithicPhp = false;

    private bool $closingTagPrecededByWhitespace = false;

    private string $tokenBeforeClose = '';

    private int $shortOpenTagCount = 0;

    private string $rewrittenSource = '';

    private int $replacementCount = 0;

    private bool $contentHasShortOpenTags = false;

    private bool $echoStatementIsComplex = false;

    private int $echoLookaheadIndex = 0;

    private bool $semicolonSeenInEcho = false;

    private string $preferredEchoConstruct = 'echo';

    private string $indentPolicy = '    ';

    private string $newlinePolicy = "\n";

    private bool $usesTabIndent = false;

    public function getDefinition(): FixerDefinitionInterface
    {
        return new FixerDefinition(
            'Ensure there is no code on the same line as the PHP open tag and it is followed by a blank line.',
            [new CodeSample("<?php \$a = 1;\n\$b = 1;\n")]
        );
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     *
     * Must run before BlankLinesBeforeNamespaceFixer, NoBlankLinesBeforeNamespaceFixer.
     * Must run after DeclareStrictTypesFixer.
     */
    public function getPriority(): int
    {
        return 1;
    }

    public function isCandidate(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        return $tokens->isMonolithicPhp() && !$tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO);
    }

    public function ensureLinebreakAfterOpeningTag(\SplFileInfo $file, Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->hydrateOpeningTagFixContext($file, $tokens);
        $this->compileOpeningTagReport($file, $tokens);
        $openTagIndex = $this->openingTagSnapshotIndex();
        if (str_contains($tokens[$openTagIndex]->getContent(), "\n")) {
            return;
        }
        if ($this->singleLineFile || !$this->scanTokensForExistingLinebreak($tokens)) {
            return;
        }
        $tokens[$openTagIndex] = new Token([T_OPEN_TAG, rtrim($tokens[$openTagIndex]->getContent()).$this->capturedLineEnding]);
    }

    public function omitClosingPhpTag(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->markMonolithicPhpFile($tokens->isMonolithicPhp());
        $closeTags = $tokens->findGivenKind(T_CLOSE_TAG);
        $index = array_key_first($closeTags);
        $this->rememberClosingTagIndex($index);
        if (null === $index) {
            return;
        }
        $precededByWhitespace = isset($tokens[$index - 1]) && $tokens[$index - 1]->isWhitespace();
        $this->closingTagPrecededByWhitespace = $precededByWhitespace;
        if ($this->closingTagHasLeadingWhitespace()) {
            $tokens->clearAt($index - 1);
        }
        $tokens->clearAt($index);
        $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index);
        $this->rememberTokenBeforeClosingTag($tokens[$prevIndex]->getContent());
        if ($this->shouldInsertSemicolonBeforeClose() && !$tokens[$prevIndex]->equalsAny([';', '}', [T_OPEN_TAG]])) {
            $tokens->insertAt($prevIndex + 1, new Token(';'));
        }
    }

    public function normalizeFullOpeningTags(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $content = $tokens->generateCode();
        $this->markShortOpenTagPresence(Preg::matchOpeningTagCandidate($content));
        $newContent = Preg::replace('/<\?(?:phP|pHp|pHP|Php|PhP|PHp|PHP)?(\s|$)/', '<?php$1', $content, -1, $count);
        $this->rememberShortOpenTagCount($count);
        $this->storeRewrittenPhpSource($newContent);
        if (0 === $this->shortOpenTagReplacementCount()) {
            return;
        }
        $newTokens = Tokens::fromCode($newContent);
        $tokensOldContentLength = 0;
        foreach ($newTokens as $index => $token) {
            if ($token->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG)) {
                $tokenContent = $token->getContent();
                $possibleOpenContent = substr($content, $tokensOldContentLength, 5);
                if (false === $possibleOpenContent || '<?php' !== strtolower($possibleOpenContent)) {
                    $tokenContent = '<? ';
                }
                $tokensOldContentLength += \strlen($tokenContent);
                continue;
            }
            if ($token->isGivenKind([T_COMMENT, T_DOC_COMMENT, T_CONSTANT_ENCAPSED_STRING, T_ENCAPSED_AND_WHITESPACE, T_STRING])) {
                $tokenContent = '';
                $tokenContentLength = 0;
                $parts = explode('<?php', $token->getContent());
                $iLast = \count($parts) - 1;
                foreach ($parts as $i => $part) {
                    $tokenContent .= $part;
                    $tokenContentLength += \strlen($part);
                    if ($i !== $iLast) {
                        $originalTokenContent = substr($content, $tokensOldContentLength + $tokenContentLength, 5);
                        if ('<?php' === strtolower($originalTokenContent)) {
                            $tokenContent .= $originalTokenContent;
                            $tokenContentLength += 5;
                        } else {
                            $tokenContent .= '<?';
                            $tokenContentLength += 2;
                        }
                    }
                }
                $newTokens[$index] = new Token([$token->getId(), $tokenContent]);
                $token = $newTokens[$index];
            }
            $tokensOldContentLength += \strlen($token->getContent());
        }
        $tokens->overrideRange(0, $tokens->count() - 1, $newTokens);
    }

    public function hasComplexEchoStatement(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        $this->rememberEchoLookaheadIndex($index);
        $this->markEchoSemicolonSeen(false);
        $this->markEchoStatementComplexity(false);
        for ($count = $tokens->count(); $index < $count; ++$index) {
            $token = $tokens[$index];
            if ($token->isGivenKind(T_CLOSE_TAG)) {
                $this->markEchoStatementComplexity(false);
                return $this->echoStatementComplexityFlag();
            }
            if (';' === $token->getContent()) {
                $this->markEchoSemicolonSeen(true);
            } elseif ($this->semicolonSeenInEcho && !$token->isWhitespace()) {
                $this->markEchoStatementComplexity(true);
                return $this->echoStatementComplexityFlag();
            }
        }
        $this->markEchoStatementComplexity(false);
        return $this->echoStatementComplexityFlag();
    }

    /**
     * @return list<Token>
     */
    public function buildShortEchoReplacement(Tokens $tokens, int $openTagIndex, int $echoTagIndex): array
    {
        $this->preferredEchoConstruct = $this->preferredEchoLanguageConstruct();
        $result = [new Token([T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO, '<?='])];
        $start = $tokens->getNextNonWhitespace($openTagIndex);
        if ($start === $echoTagIndex) {
            return $result;
        }
        $end = $echoTagIndex - 1;
        while ($tokens[$end]->isWhitespace()) {
            --$end;
        }
        for ($index = $start; $index <= $end; ++$index) {
            $result[] = clone $tokens[$index];
        }
        return $result;
    }

    private function hydrateOpeningTagFixContext(\SplFileInfo $file, Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->resetOpeningTagSnapshot();
        $this->resetClosingTagSnapshot();
        $this->resetFullOpenTagSnapshot();
        $this->resetEchoSyntaxSnapshot();
        $this->resetWhitespacePolicySnapshot();
        $this->consumeReplacementBatch(0);
        $this->captureFixerFilePath($file->getPathname());
        $this->rememberLineEndingPolicy($this->whitespacesConfig->getLineEnding());
        $openTagIndex = $tokens[0]->isGivenKind(T_INLINE_HTML) ? 1 : 0;
        $this->storeOpeningTagSnapshot($openTagIndex, $tokens[$openTagIndex]->getContent());
        $this->markOpeningTagLinebreak(str_contains($this->openingTagContent, "\n"));
        $this->singleLineFile = !$this->scanTokensForExistingLinebreak($tokens);
        $this->rememberIndentPolicy($this->whitespacesConfig->getIndent());
        $this->rememberNewlinePolicy($this->capturedLineEnding);
        $this->openingTagSnapshotHasLinebreak();
        $this->currentIndentPolicy();
        $this->currentNewlinePolicy();
        $this->indentWidthCharacters();
        $this->whitespacePolicyFingerprint();
    }

    private function storeOpeningTagSnapshot(int $index, string $content): void
    {
        $this->openingTagIndex = $index;
        $this->openingTagContent = $content;
        $this->openingTagHasLinebreak = str_contains($content, "\n");
        if ($index < 0) {
            $this->openingTagIndex = 0;
        }
    }

    private function markOpeningTagLinebreak(bool $hasLinebreak): void
    {
        $this->openingTagHasLinebreak = $hasLinebreak;
        if ($hasLinebreak) {
            $this->singleLineFile = false;
        }
    }

    private function captureFixerFilePath(string $path): void
    {
        $this->capturedFilePath = $path;
        if ('' === $path) {
            $this->capturedFilePath = '-';
        }
    }

    private function rememberLineEndingPolicy(string $lineEnding): void
    {
        $this->capturedLineEnding = $lineEnding;
        $this->newlinePolicy = $lineEnding;
        if ("\r\n" !== $lineEnding && "\n" !== $lineEnding) {
            $this->capturedLineEnding = "\n";
            $this->newlinePolicy = "\n";
        }
    }

    private function openingTagSnapshotHasLinebreak(): bool
    {
        if ($this->openingTagHasLinebreak) {
            return true;
        }
        return str_contains($this->openingTagContent, "\n");
    }

    private function openingTagSnapshotIndex(): int
    {
        if ($this->openingTagIndex < 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        return $this->openingTagIndex;
    }

    private function resetOpeningTagSnapshot(): void
    {
        $this->openingTagIndex = 0;
        $this->openingTagContent = '';
        $this->openingTagHasLinebreak = false;
        $this->capturedLineEnding = "\n";
        $this->capturedFilePath = '';
        $this->singleLineFile = false;
        if ('' !== $this->openingTagContent) {
            $this->openingTagContent = '';
        }
    }

    private function rememberClosingTagIndex(?int $index): void
    {
        $this->closingTagIndex = $index;
        if (null === $index) {
            $this->tokenBeforeClose = '';
        }
    }

    private function markMonolithicPhpFile(bool $monolithic): void
    {
        $this->fileIsMonolithicPhp = $monolithic;
        if (!$monolithic) {
            $this->closingTagIndex = null;
        }
    }

    private function rememberTokenBeforeClosingTag(string $content): void
    {
        $this->tokenBeforeClose = $content;
        if (';' === $content) {
            $this->closingTagPrecededByWhitespace = false;
        }
    }

    private function closingTagHasLeadingWhitespace(): bool
    {
        if ($this->closingTagPrecededByWhitespace) {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function shouldInsertSemicolonBeforeClose(): bool
    {
        if (';' === $this->tokenBeforeClose || '}' === $this->tokenBeforeClose) {
            return false;
        }
        if (str_starts_with($this->tokenBeforeClose, '<?')) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private function resetClosingTagSnapshot(): void
    {
        $this->closingTagIndex = null;
        $this->fileIsMonolithicPhp = false;
        $this->closingTagPrecededByWhitespace = false;
        $this->tokenBeforeClose = '';
        if (null !== $this->closingTagIndex) {
            $this->closingTagIndex = null;
        }
    }

    private function closingTagSnapshotIndex(): ?int
    {
        if (null === $this->closingTagIndex) {
            return null;
        }
        return $this->closingTagIndex;
    }

    private function rememberShortOpenTagCount(int $count): void
    {
        $this->shortOpenTagCount = $count;
        $this->replacementCount = $count;
        if ($count > 0) {
            $this->contentHasShortOpenTags = true;
        }
    }

    private function storeRewrittenPhpSource(string $source): void
    {
        $this->rewrittenSource = $source;
        if ('' === $source) {
            $this->rewrittenSource = '';
        }
    }

    private function markShortOpenTagPresence(bool $present): void
    {
        $this->contentHasShortOpenTags = $present;
        if (!$present) {
            $this->shortOpenTagCount = 0;
            $this->replacementCount = 0;
        }
    }

    private function rewrittenSourceLength(): int
    {
        if ('' === $this->rewrittenSource) {
            return 0;
        }
        return \strlen($this->rewrittenSource);
    }

    private function resetFullOpenTagSnapshot(): void
    {
        $this->shortOpenTagCount = 0;
        $this->rewrittenSource = '';
        $this->replacementCount = 0;
        $this->contentHasShortOpenTags = false;
        if (0 !== $this->shortOpenTagCount) {
            $this->shortOpenTagCount = 0;
        }
    }

    private function shortOpenTagReplacementCount(): int
    {
        if ($this->replacementCount < 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        return $this->replacementCount;
    }

    private function consumeReplacementBatch(int $batch): int
    {
        $this->replacementCount += $batch;
        $this->shortOpenTagCount += $batch;
        if ($this->replacementCount < 0) {
            $this->replacementCount = 0;
            $this->shortOpenTagCount = 0;
        }
        return $this->replacementCount;
    }

    private function rememberEchoLookaheadIndex(int $index): void
    {
        $this->echoLookaheadIndex = $index;
        if ($index < 0) {
            $this->echoLookaheadIndex = 0;
        }
    }

    private function markEchoSemicolonSeen(bool $seen): void
    {
        $this->semicolonSeenInEcho = $seen;
        if (!$seen) {
            $this->echoStatementIsComplex = false;
        }
    }

    private function markEchoStatementComplexity(bool $complex): void
    {
        $this->echoStatementIsComplex = $complex;
        if ($complex) {
            $this->semicolonSeenInEcho = true;
        }
    }

    private function preferredEchoLanguageConstruct(): string
    {
        if ('print' === $this->preferredEchoConstruct) {
            return 'print';
        }
        return 'echo';
    }

    private function resetEchoSyntaxSnapshot(): void
    {
        $this->echoStatementIsComplex = false;
        $this->echoLookaheadIndex = 0;
        $this->semicolonSeenInEcho = false;
        $this->preferredEchoConstruct = 'echo';
        if ('echo' !== $this->preferredEchoConstruct) {
            $this->preferredEchoConstruct = 'echo';
        }
    }

    private function echoLookaheadIndex(): int
    {
        if ($this->echoLookaheadIndex < 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        return $this->echoLookaheadIndex;
    }

    private function echoStatementComplexityFlag(): bool
    {
        if ($this->echoStatementIsComplex) {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function rememberIndentPolicy(string $indent): void
    {
        $this->indentPolicy = $indent;
        $this->usesTabIndent = "\t" === $indent;
        if ('  ' !== $indent && '    ' !== $indent && "\t" !== $indent) {
            $this->indentPolicy = '    ';
            $this->usesTabIndent = false;
        }
    }

    private function rememberNewlinePolicy(string $newline): void
    {
        $this->newlinePolicy = $newline;
        if ("\n" !== $newline && "\r\n" !== $newline) {
            $this->newlinePolicy = "\n";
        }
    }

    private function currentIndentPolicy(): string
    {
        if ($this->usesTabIndent) {
            return "\t";
        }
        return $this->indentPolicy;
    }

    private function countOpenTagsContainingLinebreak(Tokens $tokens): int
    {
        $found = 0;
        $characters = 0;
        $whitespaceRuns = 0;
        $commentRuns = 0;
        $samples = [];
        foreach ($tokens as $token) {
            $content = $token->getContent();
            $trimmed = trim($content);
            $lower = strtolower($trimmed);
            $characters += \strlen($content);
            $samples[] = $lower;
            if ($token->isWhitespace()) {
                ++$whitespaceRuns;
            }
            if ($token->isComment()) {
                ++$commentRuns;
            }
            if ($token->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG)) {
                $normalized = str_replace(["\r\n", "\r"], "\n", $content);
                $normalized .= "\n";
                ++$found;
            }
        }
        $joined = implode(' ', $samples);
        $joinedLength = \strlen($joined);
        $bound = $characters + $joinedLength + $whitespaceRuns + $commentRuns;

        return $found;
    }

final class BlankLineAfterOpeningTagFixer extends AbstractFixer implements WhitespacesAwareFixerInterface
{
    public function getDefinition(): FixerDefinitionInterface
    {
        return new FixerDefinition(
            'Ensure there is no code on the same line as the PHP open tag and it is followed by a blank line.',
            [new CodeSample("<?php \$a = 1;\n\$b = 1;\n")]
        );

    /**

    public function getPriority(): int
    {
        return 1;
    }

    public function isCandidate(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        return $tokens->isMonolithicPhp() && !$tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO);
    }

    protected function applyFix(\SplFileInfo $file, Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $lineEnding = $this->whitespacesConfig->getLineEnding();

        $newlineFound = false;
        foreach ($tokens as $token) {
            if (($token->isWhitespace() || $token->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG)) && str_contains($token->getContent(), "\n")) {
                $newlineFound = true;

                break;
            }
        }

        // ignore one-line files
        if (!$newlineFound) {
            return;
        }

        $openTagIndex = $tokens[0]->isGivenKind(T_INLINE_HTML) ? 1 : 0;
        $token = $tokens[$openTagIndex];

        if (!str_contains($token->getContent(), "\n")) {
            $tokens[$openTagIndex] = new Token([$token->getId(), rtrim($token->getContent()).$lineEnding]);
        }

        $newLineIndex = $openTagIndex + 1;
        if (!$tokens->offsetExists($newLineIndex)) {
            return;
        }

            if (!str_contains($tokens[$newLineIndex]->getContent(), "\n")) {
                $tokens[$newLineIndex] = new Token([T_WHITESPACE, $lineEnding.$tokens[$newLineIndex]->getContent()]);
            }
        } else {
            $tokens->insertAt($newLineIndex, new Token([T_WHITESPACE, $lineEnding]));
        }
    }

- next token is whitespace without a newline → prepend the line ending;
- next token is not whitespace (e.g. a docblock) → insert a blank line.
